title: Some Like It Hot
synopsis: Two musicians, a massacre witnessed, a girl's band on a train, and a millionaire on a yacht who is not easy to discourage.

nodes.text: Chicago, 1929, machine guns and a snow boot stuck on a wet floor.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Run” back. Smart shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Brave.

nodes.text: Sweet Sue's Society Syncopators, Florida, three weeks of bus rides.

choices.consequence: “Take the gig” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Reckless.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honest—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: He shrugs at the wheel and the boat goes on toward open water.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Laugh.” The story records the instinct as “Heart” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Sugar at the bow, Daphne at the stern, Osgood at the helm. None of you knows what the next harbor looks like, and all of you agree to look together.
You and Sugar slip off at the next pier into a small life with a small band and a small apartment and a very large amount of love.
You go ashore at a strange town with no act and no friends and you start an honest life that nobody, including you, expected.
